title: Tarte Tatin
hookLine: France-inspired tarte tatin with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Roll the pastry to a 3mm-thick round on a lightly floured surface and cut a 24cm circle, using a plate as a guide. Lightly prick all over with a fork, wrap in cling film on a baking sheet and freeze while preparing the apples. Incorporate {m52909_1}, {m52909_2}, {m52909_3}, and {m52909_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure puff pastry first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Heat oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Peel, quarter and core the apples. Put the sugar in a flameproof 20cm ceramic Tatin dish or a 20cm ovenproof heavy-based frying pan and place over a medium-high heat. Cook the sugar for 5-7 mins to a dark amber caramel syrup that’s starting to smoke, then turn off the heat and stir in the 60g diced chilled butter. Incorporate {m52909_5} and {m52909_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: To assemble the Tarte Tatin, arrange the apple quarters very tightly in a circle around the edge of the dish first, rounded-side down, then fill in the middle in a similar fashion. Gently press with your hands to ensure there are no gaps. Brush the fruit with the melted butter.

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Bake in the oven for 30 mins, then remove and place the disc of frozen puff pastry on top – it will quickly defrost. Tuck the edges down the inside of the dish and, with a knife, prick a few holes in the pastry to allow steam to escape. Bake for a further 40-45 mins until the pastry is golden brown and crisp.

steps.title: Viral Finish: Tarte Tatin
steps.instructionTemplate: Allow to cool to room temperature for 1 hr before running a knife around the edge of the dish and inverting it onto a large serving plate that is deep enough to contain the juices. Serve with crème fraîche or vanilla ice cream.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
